Nothing matches.

Every voice is synthetic — a free Microsoft neural voice, pitched and paced per character, then put through one of 13 processing chains (an octave underneath for the titans, a growl twin for the demons, a bandpass and bit-crush for the machines). No real actor was copied and no audio was taken from any film or game.
